This is a company-managed device. While tracking is on, the app records this device\'s location (latitude, longitude, accuracy, time, source and street address) about every %1$d minute(s), including when the app is closed or the screen is locked, and sends it to your organization\'s server.\n\nA notification is always shown while tracking is active. Location is only collected while tracking is on.
Tracking is on: please keep Location switched on. Indoors, or anywhere GPS cannot reach, the app works out the position from nearby mobile towers and WiFi networks, and that only works while Location stays on.
Location access is needed to record where this device is. Choose \"Precise\" when asked.
On the next screen choose \"Allow all the time\" so tracking continues when the app is closed or the screen is off.
This permission can only be changed in the app settings. Open settings, then allow it.
To keep tracking reliable while the device is idle, allow the app to run without battery restrictions.
